derivedObjectPatterns.coherenceGuard: Use one rail width and one accent role across sibling cards.
Rule weight stays subordinate to title text.
Tabs share size and use brightness sequence.
Chip never enters the text safe area.
Bracket height follows text block height, not full card height.
Dot center aligns to the first text line midpoint.
Tint is lower contrast than text and consistent across rows.
Only one chip in a local group may use contrast color.
Use surface-line stroke unless selected as the lead item.
Meter length must map to data value.
Notch width remains fixed across siblings.
Pin stays inside image safe area with readable contrast.
Underlay supports readability without hiding the subject.
Ribbon height is smaller than number height.
Icon stays smaller than body line-height.
Rules share color and differ only by opacity.
Use one shadow depth per slide.
Bar widths align across peer cards.
Same-role nodes use one connector color.
Node centers align on one baseline.
Use complementary colors only for true oppositions.
Italic applies only to quote body; labels remain upright.
Number uses display scale; caption stays body/caption scale.
Markers are monotone or accent1 only.
Label font size is not smaller than description.
Uppercase overline only when under 18 characters.
Band uses surface tint and never competes with lead accent.
Arc must map to status or progress using real arc geometry.
Ring thickness remains proportional.
Reserve image width before text fitting.
Align to table column rhythm.
Same-role connectors share arrow style and color.
Use when decoration would reduce readability.
Ticket affordance must encode grouping or sectioning.
Clip is small and never covers text.
Holes are decorative only when document metaphor is explicit.
Tape opacity stays low and text remains normal weight.
Tail points to the referenced object.
Sash cannot cross body copy.
All pills share height and baseline.
Fold is smaller than title cap height group.
Offsets are consistent and shallow.
Use only two or three sets; labels remain outside or centered.
Quadrants share geometry; emphasis uses stroke/tab.
Steps rise monotonically and labels keep one baseline offset.
Arrow style stays constant around the loop.
Outer nodes use equal radius and do not cross connectors.
Markers align to one line and labels alternate only when needed.
Cards keep equal gutter from line.
Highlight only one current step unless multiple selected states exist.
Labels align to tangent starts and do not overlap ring.
Needle/arc maps to value; caption stays secondary.
All bars share scale and baseline.
Backdrop opacity stays below foreground text contrast.
Labels attach to real image features, not invented decoration.
Use object-fit cover/contain according to subject inspection.
Caption rail never overlaps image subject.
Chips wrap on grid; no random chip colors.
Dots align to row midpoints and use limited semantic colors.
Tint progression follows monochromatic or split-complementary rule.
